name: PTD-OPA-001: attributes the subject writes about themselves
description: Reads of a field the subject of the request can write in their own record, confirmed by the write model.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Rule)-[e:PTD_Reads]->(:PTD_Attribute)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-001' IN e.patterns
RETURN p

name: PTD-OPA-001: candidates the write model does not settle
description: Reads of a field indexed by the subject of the request, where no write model says who writes it. Each one is a question for whoever knows the system around OPA.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Rule)-[e:PTD_Reads]->(:PTD_Attribute)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-001' IN e.candidate_patterns
RETURN p

name: PTD-OPA-001: escalations that start with a write to one's own record
description: The escalations the chain with PTD-OPA-003 draws: the principal writes a field of their own record and reaches the position of another. via_write_path names the write.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Principal)-[e:PTD_CanEscalateTo]->(:PTD_Principal)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-003' IN e.patterns
RETURN p

name: PTD-OPA-001: one row per read
description: Where each read of a self-written field is, to open the policy at the right line.
query:
MATCH (r:PTD_Rule)-[e:PTD_Reads]->(a:PTD_Attribute)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-001' IN e.patterns
RETURN r.name AS rule, a.name AS attribute, e.ref AS ref, e.source_file AS file, e.source_line AS line

name: PTD-OPA-002: checks of a decision declared to deny
description: The same gaps in decisions the enforcement point reads as a refusal, such as a violation of Gatekeeper, declared with -deny-entrypoint.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Rule)-[e:PTD_Reads]->(:PTD_Attribute)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-002' IN e.patterns AND e.enforcing_side STARTS WITH 'entrypoint declared to deny'
RETURN p

name: PTD-OPA-002: checks that do not apply to part of the data
description: Reads on the side of a decision that denies, of a path some documents do not have: for those documents the check produces nothing and the request goes through.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Rule)-[e:PTD_Reads]->(:PTD_Attribute)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-002' IN e.patterns
RETURN p

name: PTD-OPA-002: where each check is missing
description: The documents each check does not reach, out of how many were tried.
query:
MATCH (r:PTD_Rule)-[e:PTD_Reads]->(a:PTD_Attribute)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-002' IN e.patterns
RETURN r.name AS rule, a.name AS attribute, e.uncovered_keys AS uncovered, e.keys_checked AS checked
ORDER BY checked DESC

name: PTD-OPA-003: one row per position
category: Transitive grant through an intermediate object
description: Each position, with the decision, what it grants through the relation, and what it grants without it.
query:
MATCH (p:PTD_Principal)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-003' IN p.candidate_patterns
UNWIND p.positions AS position
RETURN p.name AS principal, position

name: PTD-OPA-003: positions worth taking
category: Transitive grant through an intermediate object
description: Principals who reach, through a hierarchy, what they would not reach without it. A position is a target, not a defect: see who can take one.
query:
MATCH (p:PTD_Principal)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-003' IN p.candidate_patterns
RETURN p

name: PTD-OPA-003: what a position worth taking reaches
category: Transitive grant through an intermediate object
description: What the holders of a position worth taking can do, given the data as it stands.
query:
MATCH q = (p:PTD_Principal)-[:PTD_CanPerform]->()
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-003' IN p.candidate_patterns
RETURN q

name: PTD-OPA-003: who can take a position
category: Transitive grant through an intermediate object
description: The escalations toward a position worth taking: the principal can write the field that puts them there. reach_transitive and reach_direct are the ways of getting in with the relation and without it.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Principal)-[e:PTD_CanEscalateTo]->(:PTD_Principal)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-003' IN e.patterns
RETURN p

name: PTD-OPA-004: decisions that believe an external source
description: Values a decision reads from the answer of a call, and the endpoint that gives it: whoever controls that endpoint decides in the policy's place.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Rule)-[e:PTD_Reads]->(:PTD_Attribute)-[:PTD_TaintedBy]->(:PTD_Principal)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-004' IN e.patterns
RETURN p

name: PTD-OPA-004: destinations the policy computes
description: Calls whose destination is not written in the policy. When the request can steer it, whoever asks also chooses who the policy asks.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Rule)-[e:PTD_Reads]->(:PTD_Attribute)-[:PTD_TaintedBy]->(s:PTD_Principal)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-004' IN e.patterns AND s.name STARTS WITH 'http.send at '
RETURN p

name: PTD-OPA-004: external sources by the rules that believe them
description: Each endpoint, with how many reads of its answers reach a decision.
query:
MATCH (r:PTD_Rule)-[e:PTD_Reads]->(:PTD_Attribute)-[:PTD_TaintedBy]->(s:PTD_Principal)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-004' IN e.patterns
RETURN s.name AS source, count(r) AS reads
ORDER BY reads DESC

name: PTD-OPA-005: checks that stop applying when a source does not answer
description: Reads of an answer on the side that denies: when the endpoint is down the check produces nothing and the request goes through.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Rule)-[e:PTD_Reads]->(:PTD_Attribute)-[:PTD_TaintedBy]->(:PTD_Principal)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-005' IN e.patterns
RETURN p

name: PTD-OPA-005: failures nothing can make fatal
description: The same checks where the call asks for raise_error false, so strict-builtin-errors has no error left to stop.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Rule)-[e:PTD_Reads]->(:PTD_Attribute)-[:PTD_TaintedBy]->(:PTD_Principal)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-005' IN e.patterns AND e.mitigation STARTS WITH 'raise_error is false'
RETURN p

name: PTD-OPA-005: one row per check
description: Each check that fails open, the endpoint it waits for, and what can still stop the failure.
query:
MATCH (r:PTD_Rule)-[e:PTD_Reads]->(:PTD_Attribute)-[:PTD_TaintedBy]->(s:PTD_Principal)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-005' IN e.patterns
RETURN r.name AS rule, s.name AS source, e.mitigation AS mitigation

name: PTD-OPA-006: escalations through a write another decision allows
category: A grant split across two decisions
description: A decision lets the principal write a value that a second decision grants on, and a principal who holds that value today is where the write leads.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Principal)-[e:PTD_CanEscalateTo]->(:PTD_Principal)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-006' IN e.patterns
RETURN p

name: PTD-OPA-006: one row per escalation
category: A grant split across two decisions
description: Who writes what, through which endpoint, allowed by which decision, and granted by which.
query:
MATCH (a:PTD_Principal)-[e:PTD_CanEscalateTo]->(b:PTD_Principal)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-006' IN e.patterns
RETURN a.name AS principal, b.name AS reaches, e.value AS value, e.via AS via, e.authorized_by AS allowed_by, e.decision AS granted_by

name: PTD-OPA-006: what those escalations open
category: A grant split across two decisions
description: The same escalations, followed by what the principal at the far end can do.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Principal)-[e:PTD_CanEscalateTo]->(:PTD_Principal)-[:PTD_CanPerform]->()
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-006' IN e.patterns
RETURN p

name: PTD-OPA-007: decisions that pass when a collection is empty
description: The same, where the rule is a decision the enforcement point asks for directly.
query:
MATCH (r:PTD_Rule)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-007' IN r.patterns AND r.is_decision = true
RETURN r

name: PTD-OPA-007: one row per collection
description: Each rule and the collection whose emptiness it does not guard against.
query:
MATCH (r:PTD_Rule)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-007' IN r.patterns
UNWIND r.empty_domains AS collection
RETURN r.name AS rule, collection

name: PTD-OPA-007: rules that pass when a collection is empty
description: Rules holding an every on the side that grants, over a collection the request or the data can leave empty. With nothing to check, the every is true.
query:
MATCH (r:PTD_Rule)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-007' IN r.patterns
RETURN r

name: PTD-OPA-008: documents that decide for anybody
description: A document every request shares, which a decision reads for a principal no document names: whoever writes it decides for everybody at once.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Rule)-[e:PTD_Reads]->(:PTD_Attribute)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-008' IN e.patterns
RETURN p

name: PTD-OPA-008: one row per document
description: Each document and the rule that reads it for anybody.
query:
MATCH (r:PTD_Rule)-[e:PTD_Reads]->(a:PTD_Attribute)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-008' IN e.patterns
RETURN a.name AS document, r.name AS rule, e.ref AS ref

name: PTD-OPA-008: who can flip them
description: The same documents, and whoever the write model says can write them.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Rule)-[e:PTD_Reads]->(:PTD_Attribute)-[:PTD_WrittenBy]->(:PTD_Principal)
WHERE 'PTD-OPA-008' IN e.patterns
RETURN p

name: Petard: every escalation
description: Every principal that can reach the position another one holds, by writing something it is allowed to write. The edges come from PTD-OPA-003 and PTD-OPA-006.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Principal)-[:PTD_CanEscalateTo]->(:PTD_Principal)
RETURN p

name: Petard: what an escalation opens
description: The escalations, followed by what the principal at their far end can do: what the one who escalates would get.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Principal)-[:PTD_CanEscalateTo]->(:PTD_Principal)-[:PTD_CanPerform]->()
RETURN p

name: Petard: what each principal can do
description: What each principal can get out of each decision, given the data as it stands. The condition property is what still has to hold.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Principal)-[:PTD_CanPerform]->()
RETURN p

name: Petard: who writes what the decisions read
description: The attributes the decisions depend on, and whoever the write model says can write them.
query:
MATCH p = (:PTD_Rule)-[:PTD_Reads]->(:PTD_Attribute)-[:PTD_WrittenBy]->(:PTD_Principal)
RETURN p
